AzureCspExportDetails.description:
Connecting bill with exports is Recommended.

When ExportDetails are provided, the bill connect will gather billing information using exports set-up by the users.
Otherwise, the bill connect will rely on Azure's Cost Management APIs to gather billing information.

ExportDetails indicates the location of Actual and Amortized cost data exports stored in
Azure Blob Storage and provides option to trigger an export.
Both locations are mandatory if the underlying Azure EA Bill Connect must use exports. The file partitioning must be
enabled while creating an export and granularity must be set to daily. If an export was made on the GUI all you have
to do is to make sure that the *Export Type* is set to *Daily export of month-to-date costs*.

The storage location being provided must contain usage details for all the billing periods which the user is interested in.
If we fail to find the usage data for a given billing period, we assume there was no usage.

Each export must be for a time period of exactly one month. You can verify this by making sure all the folders
saved by the export are formatted as such: YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD where the dates are the first and last dates of the month respectively.

For Azure CSP Subscription scope, exportDetails is mandatory.

See [Export set up](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cost-management-billing/costs/tutorial-export-acm-data?tabs=azure-portal)
for more details on how to create an export for both Actual and Amortized cost and enable file partitioning.

amortizedCostExportURL.description: URL of Azure CSP amortized cost data which has been set up using an export.

enableOOBExports.description: Enable Flexera to trigger Out-of-band (OOB) exports to generate cost data more frequently than once per day.

AzureCspScopeDetailsWithScopeType.description:
Scope Details allow users to specify the scope of the configured exports.
The scope can be either a billing account, billing profile, customer tenant, or subscription.
If no scope details are provided, billing account scope is assumed to be the default.
The Billing Profile ID, along with the Billing Account ID, is required to gather billing data for a specific billing profile.
The Customer Tenant ID, along with the Billing Account ID, is required to gather billing data for a specific customer tenant.
For Subscription scope, the Billing Account ID is not available for tier-2 CSPs. Instead, the Subscription ID is used to gather billing data for tier-2 CSP customers.

scopeType.description: The type of the scope. Possible values: "Billing Account", "Billing Profile", "Customer Tenant", "Subscription".

info.description:
The FinOps Onboarding API allows customers to connect and manage cloud bills by providing
required billing information and/or credentials to their cloud vendors. The API returns conflict upon registering the same
cloud account in an organization if it is already registered.

The API is available at the following endpoints, dependent upon the user/tenant zone:
| Zone        | Base URL    |

delete.description:
Deletes an Azure CSP bill connect associated with a given bill connect ID.
Bill Connects provisioned through Unified Onboarding are read-only in this API. Update and delete operations will be rejected with a 403 Forbidden. Use Unified Onboarding to manage these resources.
You can identify these Bill Connects by the onboardingOrigin field:
- "platform": created via Unified Onboarding
- "finops": created and managed through this API (default)

tags.description:
Bill connect also referred as Generic Bill Connect, provides a resource to fetch the bill information
of connected bills across all cloud vendors.
tags.name: Bill Connect

tags.description:
AWS bill connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining AWS bill connections.
   This offer two ways of connecting AWS bills, using IAM Role (cross-account role) or IAM user.
   The preferred method for connecting to AWS, cross-account roles allow you to grant Flexera access to your account in a defined and constrained way.
   IAM users provide broad access to AWS services. Where possible, we recommend using cross-account roles.

See
[FinOps Bill Connect Configs AWS](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Administration/BillConnectConfigsAWS.htm)
for more details.
tags.name: Bill Connect - AWS

tags.description:
Azure EA (Enterprise Agreement) Management Bill Connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining Azure EA Bill Connections at Billing or Enrollment Account scopes.
This bill connect uses Azure's Service Principals with a Client Secret under the hood for authentication with Microsoft's APIs.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Azure EA Management

tags.description:
Common Bill Ingestion(CBI) bill connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining CBI bill
    connections.

See
[FinOps Bill Connect Configs CBI](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Administration/BillConnectConfigsCBI.htm)
for more details.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Common Bill Ingestion

tags.description:
Azure CSP (CSP Partner Center) Bill Connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining Azure CSP Bill Connections at the Billing Account scope.
	This bill connect uses Azure's Service Principals with a Client Secret under the hood for authentication with Microsoft's APIs.
	Billing account for the CSP contains one or more billing profiles that let you manage your invoices and payment methods. 
	Each billing profile contains one or more invoice sections that let you organize costs on the billing profile's invoice.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Azure CSP

tags.description:
Azure MCA(Microsoft Customer Agreement) Bill Connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining Azure MCA Bill Connections.
	This bill connect supports scoped data ingestion at three billing levels: Billing Account (default), Billing Profile, and Invoice Section.
	This bill connect uses Azure's Service Principals with a Client Secret under the hood for authentication with Microsoft's APIs.
	Billing account for the Microsoft Customer Agreement contains one or more billing profiles that let you manage your invoices and payment methods. 
	Each billing profile contains one or more invoice sections that let you organize costs on the billing profile's invoice.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Azure MCA

tags.description:
Databricks bill connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining Databricks bill connections.
  It enables enhanced visibility and cost allocation for Databricks, improving insights into 
   service and resource usage, facilitating rightsizing and implementing actionable cost-saving strategies 
   to optimize expenses effectively.

   The Databricks bill connect is a native integration using Databricks Account API credentials
   to fetch cost and usage data directly from Databricks platform.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Databricks

tags.description:
GCP (Google Cloud Platform) bill connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining GCP bill connections.

See
[FinOps Bill Connect Configs GCP](https://docs.flexera.com/flexera/EN/Administration/BillConnectConfigsGoogle.htm)
for more details.
tags.name: Bill Connect - GCP

tags.description:
Snowflake bill connect provides a resource for registering and maintaining Snowflake bill connections.
  It enables enhanced visibility into Snowflake cost and usage, allowing better allocation, optimization,
  and reporting of Snowflake expenses across the organization.

  The Snowflake bill connect is a native integration using Snowflake Account API credentials
  with a Programmatic Access Token (PAT) to fetch cost and usage data directly from the Snowflake platform.
tags.name: Bill Connect - Snowflake
